# Canonical results

<!-- Generated by tools/research/research.py render. Edit records or scoped goals, not this view. -->

[Home](README.md) · [Results](RESULTS.md) · [Scopes](GOALS.md) · [Connections](DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Open questions](OPEN-QUESTIONS.md) · [Contribute](_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)

The single register of results: one editable JSON record per migrated claim, from which this page and each record page are generated. 244 registered results: 228 with a recorded Lean receipt (`recorded-checked`), 12 reviewed at their stated scope (`reviewed-scoped`) and 4 open targets (`open`). `recorded-checked` credits an existing Lean receipt and `reviewed-scoped` an existing substantive review; neither certifies a stronger claim. Unmigrated results retain their existing sources; files, checks and repeated acceptances are not independent results. Hash drift requires reading the changed source before updating its record.

## Where to look first

- Same theorem under two names: `trace-law-equivalence`, `derivation-soundness`. Preserve historical names and receipts; count the underlying result once.
- Similar statements with different semantics: `branching-target-uniqueness`, `joint-target-uniqueness`. Their local test languages differ.
- Three shared-support results: `draws-on-a-shared-stock`, `exclusive-footprint-support`, `joint-plan-composition`. Their common obstruction does not establish a verified translation between them.
- Completed conditional alignment argument and its AI application: `practical-judgment-g0-j`, `alignment-direction-g0-j`. The independent targets `universal-practical-warrant` and `wisdom-root` remain open.

## Discovery and evidence

[Full reading catalogue](theories/becoming/results/README.md) · [Curated generativity chain](theories/becoming/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md) · [Dated session map](theories/becoming/results/SESSION-RESULTS.md) · [Broader theory map](MAP.md)

```sh
make research-check
make research-find QUERY=your-topic
make research-render
```

Default discovery excludes frozen copies and failed build attempts. Use `--archives` deliberately to include them. Checks concern metadata and evidence bindings; mathematical changes retain their actual Lean-build requirement.
